title: fix(core): tip_count unchecked as u64 cast in sqlite_storage
description: sqlite_storage.rs tip_count() at line 236 uses row.0 as u64 on the i64 from COUNT(*). Inconsistent with the negative-value guard used elsewhere in the file (get_entry line 129). While COUNT cannot go negative in normal operation, a corrupt DB would silently wrap to a huge value.
